data.name: HexiGo
data.detailed_description:
Conquer the world, one hex at a time

HexiGo is a multiplayer strategy game where 2 to 8 players choose their civilizations and fight for control on the same hex-based world map. Your goal is simple: expand your borders, take land from your rivals, and build the largest empire on the board.

Each turn, you choose your target and decide how much territory you want to fight for. Smart decisions can grow your empire quickly, but risky moves can leave you exposed. As the map changes, every border becomes important. Who you attack, when you attack, and how much you risk can decide the fate of the match.

Choose your civilization

Play as one of multiple civilizations, including Turks, Spanish, Italians, Germans, French, Russians, Japanese, English, Iranians, Vikings, Chinese, and Koreans. Each player controls their own color and territory. As the game progresses, small border fights can turn into massive empire wars.

Simple rules, changing battles

HexiGo is easy to understand, but every match creates different situations. Sometimes the best move is to attack a weak rival. Sometimes dividing a powerful empire can completely change the balance of the game. You need to watch the map, read your opponents, and choose your moment carefully.

Features

  • Multiplayer strategy gameplay for 2 to 8 players

  • Hex-based world map focused on conquest

  • Civilization selection

  • Territory control and border expansion

  • Risk-based decision making

  • Dynamic power shifts between players

  • Clean, colorful, and readable board game visuals

There is no single path to victory in HexiGo. Expand fast, play carefully, wait for your rivals to weaken each other, or strike at the perfect moment and claim the world for yourself.
